notes:
NoDraw 0.1.0 beta 5 — Windows x64 test build

### Editing and displacements
- Undo restores the edited brush selection. Paste Special accepts Enter, keeps copied entity links local to each copy, and uses sequential names.
- Camera flight keeps arrow-key editing available. A newly tied brush entity stays visible while selected so its class can be changed.
- Displacement tools retain grid and seam settings during gestures. Boundary pins, brush and modifier previews, and exact carving preserve edges and vertex data through Undo, Redo, and saving.
- Model Viewer can convert supported model geometry to textured brushes or displacements and rebuild static-prop models. Propper retains paths and settings, splits high-vertex models into bodies, and shares generated LODs with Model Viewer.
- Material search treats a trailing slash as a folder prefix. VMT feature controls cover related reflection and Phong keys, and four-way displacement painting remembers its selected layer.

### Recovery, compilation and lighting
- After a crash, the recovery prompt can reopen an autosave and restore the saved view and selection.
- Compile Log links to the current map or areaportal leak. The pointfile picker opens at the actual output. After a graphics failure, a reopened editor can reconnect to the same compiler run.
- Lighting Preview filters direct shadows across brush lightmap cells and their matching edges.

### MCP
- Inspect brush entities by class or bounds, return PNG snapshots in a batch, and trace rays or cross-sections against distinct geometry types.
- Read BSP leaves, areas, PVS and areaportal contours. Overlay the current compile's leak on a snapshot.
- Preview a series of world-brush edits, review the outlines, then apply every step in one undoable operation.

The Windows x64 installer runs per user. Installed beta builds check for future updates. Game assets and map compilers are installed separately.

Documentation and illustrated workflows: https://env-snake.github.io/nodraw-site/
